name: hosted-webhooks
description: Hosts the package's own HTTP routes and receives Stripe deliveries at a token URL the reactor serves.

config.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
config.description: The signing secret Stripe shows when a webhook endpoint is created. Resolved server-side in policyFor and handed to core as `verify.secret`; it is never written into document state and never reaches the browser. One secret per endpoint in a deployment, so a leak from one account cannot forge another's deliveries.
